title: Editing: Montreal Bed-In by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1970
content:
An editing session took place on 10 February 1970 for footage from John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s bed-in for peace in Montreal.

The editing took place at Tattooist International in London’s Camden Town. The company was run by Nic Knowland, who worked on several film projects for Lennon, Ono, Paul McCartney, George Harrison, and Ringo Starr.

That afternoon, the Lennons went to Black House in London to film an interview for the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation, and to meet Michael X.
